purpose: User request 2026-11-08: every SMT line must be orderable from current JLC assembly stock, with the lowest height that fits the existing land pattern. Same footprint, pads, nets and placement; only the purchased identity changes. Stock was read from the JLC parts API on 2026-11-08.

substitutions.description: LRC LESD8D5.0T5G SOD-882 (1.0 x 0.6 x 0.5 mm) unidirectional VBUS ESD; VRWM 5.0 V, VBR 6.2 V min, IPP 8.7 A, 107 W (8/20 us). Pin 1 = cathode/VBUS, pin 2 = anode/GND on the existing 0.25 x 0.50 mm lands at 0.65 mm pitch. 5 V USB sink only.
substitutions.reason: C55274065 has 0 JLC stock. VRWM drops from 5.5 V to 5.0 V; still above the 5 V no-PD sink with VBR 6.2 V minimum.

substitutions.description: SGMICRO 2.93V AON status monitor (same family, same SOT-23 pin map); push-pull active-low nRESET drives PG_3V3_MAIN. Pin1GND/2nRESET/3VCC. Not a hard MCU reset or guaranteed brownout protector.
substitutions.reason: The 3.08 V T-suffix has 0 JLC stock; the 2.93 V S-suffix is the same die family and footprint. The output is a status signal only.

substitutions.description: Single-cell protector with integrated MOSFET; 4.30V overcharge/4.10V release, 2.40V overdischarge/3.0V release, 9A typ overcurrent; CPC5 (same thresholds and pin map as XB7608A). Raw cell negative on pins2/3, protected system negative on4/5.
substitutions.reason: C669688 has 0 JLC stock. The datasheet threshold table is identical (4.30/4.10/2.40/3.0 V, 9 A).

substitutions.description: SGMICRO SGM2578YG/TR WLCSP-0.9x0.9-4B, 0.5 mm pitch: A1 VOUT, A2 VIN, B1 GND, B2 EN (active high, ~560 kOhm internal pull-down). 1 V-5 V input, 1 A continuous, 1.6 A typ current limit, 54 mOhm, reverse-voltage comparator and quick output discharge.
substitutions.reason: SGM2578SD (2 A) is not stocked by JLC. SGM2578YG has the same ball map and land; continuous rating drops from 2 A to 1 A, which covers SD, touch, EPD logic and the NS4168 audio rail. The EN pull-down keeps the switch off while the XL9535 pins are still inputs.

substitutions.description: MUP U22401-23 16P mid-mount USB-C, drawing DWG-U22401-XX-01 Rev2 (same drawing as the -XX family: 11.24 x 4.00 mm slot pitch, 0.8 mm PCB, 1.60 mm above board). Variants differ only in contact plating/housing material.
substitutions.reason: U22401-17 is not stocked by JLC; U22401-23 is listed on the same family drawing.

substitutions.description: Sunlord MWSA0412S-R47MT 0.47uH +/-20%, 4.2 x 4.4 x 1.0+/-0.2 mm (1.2 mm max), DCR 21 mOhm, Isat 5.2/5.4 A. Same Sunlord MWSA04xxS land pattern (I 1.5 / J 2.2 / H 2.5 mm).
substitutions.reason: Height: 2.0 mm max -> 1.2 mm max on the same land. Isat 5.2 A covers the expected <2.5 A peak; a short-circuit at the converter current limit may saturate it.

substitutions.description: Sunlord MWSA0412S-1R0MT 1uH +/-20%, 4.2 x 4.4 x 1.0+/-0.2 mm (1.2 mm max), DCR 47 mOhm, Isat 3.8/4.4 A. Same MWSA04xxS land pattern.
substitutions.reason: Height: 2.0 mm max -> 1.2 mm max on the same land. Isat 3.8 A covers prototype charging up to about 2 A; full 3 A charging needs bench confirmation.

substitutions.description: Richtek RT6160AWSC 3 A I2C buck-boost, WL-CSP-15B 1.4x2.3 mm, 0.4 mm pitch, 0.6 mm max. Ball map identical to the U902 land (A1 EN, A2/A3 VIN, B1 VSEL, B2/B3 LX1, C1 AGND, C2/C3 PGND, D1 SCL, D2/D3 LX2, E1 SDA, E2/E3 VOUT). VSEL high: 3.45 V at power-up (VOUT2 reset 0x39); firmware writes 0x05 = 0x33 for 3.3 V (V = 2.025 V + code x 25 mV). I2C 0x75, IQ 2 uA typ, ILIM_P 4.5-5.5 A.
substitutions.reason: User decision 2026-11-08 (replaces the SGM62125 consignment): SGM62125 is not stocked; RT6160AWSC drops onto the same land with 0.47 uH. Non-mainland (Richtek, Taiwan); exact per-reference exception in verify_mainland_bom_compliance.py.
Cost-down 2026-11-08: same QST 6-axis IMU family; QMI8658B datasheet pin table (1 SDO/SA0 ... 14 SDA) and 2.5 x 3.0 mm LGA-14 are identical to QMI8658A, 0.83 mm vs 0.86 mm high; $0.95 vs $1.39 @100.

substitutions.description: LRC LRC8804DT1G 4-channel rail-clamp ESD array, DFN2510-10 (same land as LRC8804FDT1G). Datasheet Rev.C pin diagram: 1/2/4/5 I/O (USB_DP, USB_DM, CC1, CC2), 3 and 8 GND (both tied to the anode rail), 6/7/9/10 no connection. VRWM 5.5 V, VBR 6 V min, Cio 0.6 pF max, 4 A 8/20 us. USB full speed and CC only.
substitutions.reason: LRC8804FDT1G had 11 pcs at JLC on 2026-11-08 (not enough for a 5-board run with attrition). Same family, package and pin map; I/O capacitance 0.6 pF max vs 0.3 pF, fine for 12 Mbps USB and CC.
